verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents its own stealth mode, plus an Ultra Stealth Mode, for bypassing bot detection. It also documents session proxies for reaching geo-restricted content, rotating IPs and spreading requests across locations, so the core of the story is first-party. The docs never name residential proxies, never describe fingerprint randomization or which fingerprint signals stealth changes, and the only hands-on report is a user saying a visa-slot automation was blocked by Cloudflare, without saying whether stealth was enabled. Missing for 10: explicit residential proxy pools, documented stealth fingerprinting details, how geo-targeting is selected (country or city), independent evidence that stealth plus proxies gets past bot protection.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can enable stealth fingerprinting and residential or geo-targeted proxies so legitimate automations aren't blocked as bots

citations.quote: Stealth mode applies anti-detection techniques to help your automated browser sessions bypass bot detection.
Ultra Stealth Mode - The most advanced stealth mode for extra evasion from bot detection.
Route browser sessions through proxy servers to access geo-restricted content, rotate IPs, and distribute requests across different locations.
